chart.expression: SELECT FUNCREVISOR, SUM(DEFEITO) AS DEFEITO, CODFUNC FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR(CAD.NOMEFUNC, 1, INSTR(CAD.NOMEFUNC, ' ') - 1) AS FUNCREVISOR, CAD.CODFUNC, (NVL(SUM(APO.MINSERIDO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.FALTANDO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.INVERTIDO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.TROCADO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.QUEIMADO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.CURTO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.SOLDAFRIA),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.DEFEITOMP),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.CHICOTE),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.DISPLAY),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.AJUTENSAO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.ACORRENTE),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.LED),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.CONSUMO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.CORRENTE),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.PROGRAMACAO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.OUTROSDEFEITOS),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.ADESIVOTROC),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.ADESIVOTORT),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.GABARRANHADO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.GABAMASSADO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.TAMPATROCA),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.TAMPAAMASS),0)) AS DEFEITO FROM AD_APOQLD APO INNER JOIN ( SELECT CODFUNC, NOMEFUNC, CODDEP FROM ( SELECT CODFUNC, NOMEFUNC, CODDEP, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CODFUNC ORDER BY DTADM DESC) AS RN FROM TFPFUN ) WHERE RN = 1 ) CAD ON APO.FUNCREVISOR2 = CAD.CODFUNC WHERE APO.DTAPO >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND APO.DTAPO <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAD.CODDEP IN :P_SETOR GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAD.NOMEFUNC, 1, INSTR(CAD.NOMEFUNC, ' ') - 1), CAD.CODFUNC UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTR(CAD.NOMEFUNC, 1, INSTR(CAD.NOMEFUNC, ' ') - 1) AS FUNCREVISOR, CAD.CODFUNC, (NVL(SUM(APO.MINSERIDO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.FALTANDO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.INVERTIDO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.TROCADO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.QUEIMADO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.CURTO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.SOLDAFRIA),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.DEFEITOMP),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.CHICOTE),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.DISPLAY),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.AJUTENSAO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.ACORRENTE),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.LED),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.CONSUMO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.CORRENTE),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.PROGRAMACAO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.OUTROSDEFEITOS),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.ADESIVOTROC),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.ADESIVOTORT),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.GABARRANHADO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.GABAMASSADO),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.TAMPATROCA),0) + NVL(SUM(APO.TAMPAAMASS),0)) AS DEFEITO FROM AD_APOQLD APO INNER JOIN ( SELECT CODFUNC, NOMEFUNC, CODDEP FROM ( SELECT CODFUNC, NOMEFUNC, CODDEP, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CODFUNC ORDER BY DTADM DESC) AS RN FROM TFPFUN ) WHERE RN = 1 ) CAD ON APO.FUNCREVISOR = CAD.CODFUNC WHERE APO.DTAPO >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND APO.DTAPO <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAD.CODDEP IN :P_SETOR GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAD.NOMEFUNC, 1, INSTR(CAD.NOMEFUNC, ' ') -
